pairs.evidence: src/features/shared/components/forms/KeyValueEditor.tsx:169 names its key/value inputs by placeholder alone and the trash button at :183 has no name, so the catalog's repeatable-row editor reads "edit text" and "button"; src/features/shared/components/forms/PasswordToggleField.tsx:113 takes the reveal control out of the tab order (pointer-only), and src/features/shared/components/forms/PillGroup.tsx:58 is a radiogroup with no arrow model whose pills stay focusable while faded out at :65

techniques.evidence: src/features/shared/components/forms/KeyValueEditor.tsx:169 placeholder is the only name source (vanishes once typed); :183 icon-only Trash button has no aria-label; src/features/shared/components/forms/FormField.tsx:269 renders the hint with no id so it joins no describedby chain; src/features/shared/components/forms/CharBudget.tsx:59 hard-codes an English accessible name outside i18n. src/features/shared/components/forms/PasswordToggleField.tsx:113 tabIndex={-1} makes reveal unreachable by keyboard; src/features/shared/components/forms/PillGroup.tsx:76 every role=radio is its own tab stop with no arrow/roving model, and :103 injects caller content inside the radiogroup beside its members; src/features/shared/components/forms/Listbox.tsx:185 the search input sits inside role=listbox (:241) and :164 moves only a visual focusIndex with no aria-activedescendant - half of each composite model

src/features/shared/components/forms/PillGroup.tsx:65 hides the preset pills with w-0/opacity-0 while customInputActive, closing only the visual channel - the radios keep their tab stops and tree nodes (the invisible detour)

src/features/shared/components/forms/FormField.tsx:281 mounts role=alert already holding the error text (semantics #1: silent on most pairings) instead of calling the shell provider; src/features/shared/components/forms/CharBudget.tsx:59 sits in an aria-live region that changes on every keystroke - an ambient tally admitted as news

src/features/shared/components/forms/AccessibleToggle.tsx:41 is the contract done right (native button, role=switch, required label at :43, aria-checked, focus ring) and src/features/shared/components/forms/Slider.tsx:102 wraps the native range; but KeyValueEditor, PasswordToggleField and PillGroup ship the defects above to every consumer from inside the catalog

src/features/shared/components/forms/__tests__/FormErrorSummary.test.tsx:80 asserts by role and accessible name; src/features/shared/components/forms/FormErrorSummary.tsx:34 moves focus to the offending field

pairs.registryProposal: Listbox puts a search <input> inside role=listbox; keyboard-navigation-models states the owned-members invariant abstractly - a worked "filterable listbox: the input is the combobox, the popup is the listbox" counter-example would make the rule land on its commonest violation.
